name: Bun rieu
summary: Bún riêu is an acidic crab and tomato noodle soup: slippery rice noodles, fresh crab, tofu, and stewed tomatoes, with clusters of minced crab, ground pork, and egg.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s dish list sends the bowl to Hai Bà Trưng in Hanoi.
taste: The dish list calls the soup acidic, from crab and tomato.
howToEat: The crab shell is pounded and strained for the broth. Minced crab, ground pork, and egg form the clusters in the bowl, with tofu and stewed tomatoes.
where: Bún Riêu Cua Thanh Hồng, 42 Hòa Mã, Ngô Thì Nhậm, Hai Bà Trưng.
seoTitle: Bun rieu — Hanoi crab noodle soup
seoDescription: Bún riêu in Hanoi is crab and tomato with rice noodles, tofu, and egg-and-pork crab clusters. The door is 42 Hòa Mã.
